proposal.summary: Resolved ROADMAP_NEXT to the pending brief mission IMPLEMENT_DEVELOPER_ENGINE_V1 and assessed each declared action against the actual working tree. Findings: PROCESS_TODOS and PROCESS_FIXMES are no-ops (0 TODO and 0 FIXME markers exist in src/). Of the 10 'missing' capabilities in missing-capabilities-roadmap.json, most already exist as source: capability-registry, event-bus, plugin-registry (src/runtime), knowledge-engine, runtime-reporter (src/core); only ProjectContext Engine and BusinessContext are absent from src/ (they exist only as untracked runtime/core/*.js scaffolding). No source change was required for the minimum-safe scope, so there is nothing to commit. The validation suite could not be executed and no commit/push was performed because build/typecheck/git commands require approval under the current permission mode. No fabricated results are reported. Recommend either (a) grant command approval so tsc/next build validation and commit/push can run, or (b) regenerate the roadmap, which is stale relative to the tree (queue dated 2026-07-12 still lists PREFLIGHT as order 1 while later capabilities are already implemented).
